items.definition:
an Aramaic dialect that was the language of the Christian Syrians
Ancient texts were often written in Syriac.

a radioactive isotope of hydrogen
Tritium is used in some self-powered lighting.

(music) with all voices or instruments together
The orchestra played the tutti section with great power.

the state of being everywhere or in many places at once; omnipresence
The ubiquity of smartphones has changed how we communicate.

the process of becoming more urban
Urbanisation is a global trend.

the quality of being very great in extent or size
The vastness of the ocean was awe-inspiring.

the food of the gods; something delicious
The dessert was so rich and creamy, it tasted like ambrosia.

the process of developing or presenting an argument
Her argumentation was so strong that she convinced everyone.

an aromatic resin or a soothing ointment
The scent of pine balsam filled the air.

the ability to speak two languages fluently
Bilingualism offers many cognitive benefits.

The world of blogs and bloggers.
The news quickly spread throughout the blogosphere, generating much discussion.

A throwing weapon made of weights on cords, used to entangle animals.
The gaucho used a bola to catch the runaway cattle.

A type of plastic, especially used for photographic film.
Before digital, movies were shot on celluloid film.

A short, hair-like vibrating structure found on the surface of certain cells.
Cilia help to move mucus and trapped particles out of the respiratory tract.

a small wooded valley or dell
We walked through the peaceful dingle on our hike.

a serious bacterial infection
Vaccination helps prevent diseases like diphtheria.

a stimulus or boost
The new policy gave a filip to the economy.

an organized whole that is perceived as more than the sum of its parts
The painting creates a powerful gestalt.

a stick with a pointed end for driving cattle; a stimulus to action
His insults acted as a goad to her ambition.

a drink made of rum and water
Sailors used to drink grog on long voyages.

a place where a lot of a particular activity, especially an undesirable one, flourishes
The city became a hotbed of political unrest.

rude and disrespectful behavior
The student was punished for his insolence towards the teacher.

the action of urging on or inciting someone to do something
The riot occurred at the instigation of a few radical leaders.

a political ideology based on Islamic law
The rise of Islamism has been a significant factor in regional politics.

a large celebration or party, typically one held outdoors
Thousands of Scouts attended the international jamboree.

the text of an opera or other long vocal work
The composer worked closely with the librettist to create the opera.

a method for measuring distances by illuminating the target with laser light and measuring the reflection with a sensor
Lidar technology is crucial for autonomous vehicles.

a biochemical assembly that contains both lipid and protein, found in the blood plasma
High levels of low-density lipoprotein can be a risk factor for heart disease.

the state or presence of a malignant tumor; cancer
The biopsy confirmed the presence of a malignancy.

the treatment of a person, group, or concept as insignificant or peripheral
The marginalization of minority groups is a serious social issue.

the action of enrolling at a college or university
The university's matriculation ceremony is held in September.

a master or expert, especially in a particular art or craft
He's a true coffee meister, knowing everything about brewing.

the microorganisms in a particular environment (including the body or a part of the body)
Research into the human gut microbiome is rapidly expanding.

a small, precise, or trivial detail
He was obsessed with every minutia of the project.

relating to a scale of nanometers
Scientists are developing new materials at the nanoscale.

the belief that war and violence are unjustifiable
His commitment to pacifism led him to refuse military service.

the process of making policies
Effective policymaking requires careful consideration of all stakeholders.

the system in a vehicle that transmits power from the engine to the driving wheels
Engineers are working to improve the efficiency of the car's powertrain.

a high-ranking cleric
The prelate addressed the congregation.

the quality of corresponding in size, degree, or intensity
The judge emphasized the importance of proportionality in sentencing.

an Indian king or prince
The rajah ruled over a vast kingdom.

the process of a function or procedure calling itself
Understanding recursion is key to advanced programming.

the quality of being religious; religiousness
The study examined the impact of religiosity on social behavior.

the reporting of news, especially by a journalist
The documentary was praised for its honest reportage of the conflict.

a person who derives pleasure from inflicting pain, suffering, or humiliation on others
The villain in the story was portrayed as a cruel sadist.

A person or thing that screams; something outstanding or remarkable.
The goal was an absolute screamer from outside the box.

A thorough search or investigation; an initial test or trial.
The new car went through a rigorous shakedown test.

Islamic law.
Shariah law governs many aspects of life in some Islamic countries.

A dance involving rapid shaking of the body; a wobble or vibration.
The car developed a shimmy at high speeds.

Immoral or corrupt behavior; a person engaging in such behavior.
The politician was accused of financial sleaze.

Sarcastic or critical remarks; an imaginary creature.
Her blog posts are full of witty snark.

A migratory rainbow trout.
Anglers often travel long distances to fish for steelhead.

A person or thing that thrashes; a type of bird.
The brown thrasher is known for its varied song.

a type of fat found in the blood
High levels of triglyceride can increase the risk of heart disease.

the study or analysis of types or categories
The research involved a typology of different architectural styles.

the quality of being crude or offensive
He was shocked by the vulgarity of the language used in the film.

a strong desire to travel
Her wanderlust led her to explore many different countries.

a pilot house on a boat; an area of expertise
Project management is right in his wheelhouse.

absence
He was tried in absentia, as he had fled the country.

an indefinitely long period of time; an age
It felt like an aeon since they last met.

matter composed of antiparticles
Scientists are studying the properties of antimatter.

a bright blue color
The painting featured a deep azur sky.

a type of herbaceous plant, often used in salads or for medicinal purposes
The garden included various herbs, including burnet.

a violent natural event or disaster; a sudden, violent upheaval
The earthquake was a cataclysm that devastated the region.
